ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 no-show cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher and flag the driver's account for abuse of the "I'm Here" / waiting-fee process; reinforce with the driver the requirement that "I'm Here" only be pressed when GPS places him at the pick-up point.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver claims he was at the pick-up point and waited >3 min, but the GPS trace shows him stationary at ~(1.29210, 103.84712) from 14:07:30 to cancellation, ~180 m from the pin (1.2906, 103.8465) and never inside the within-200m pick-up zone; his own statement concedes he was 'a short walk from the entrance', not at it. NS-1(ii) fails, so the $6.61 no-show fee does not stand.
Rider's complaint is treated as a no-show-fee dispute under NS-0 → NS-1/NS-2, not as a rider-initiated cancellation, so NS-4 does not apply (rider did not cancel).
